name: Autodesk Revit
knownFor: The default US production BIM platform for architecture, structure, and MEP documentation.
price: Official list $3,005 / year or $380 / month (Autodesk, checked Nov 2026)
popCaption: 94.7% of firms in the Confluence 2025 AEC Tech Stack Survey · G2: 1,256 reviews, 4.6/5 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Deep documentation, worksharing, and a huge add-in ecosystem
con: Windows-only, heavy hardware needs, and a long learning curve
costCaption: Official Autodesk list: $3,005/year or $380/month for a standard subscription (autodesk.com Revit subscription FAQ, checked Nov 2026).

name: AutoCAD (including Architecture and MEP)
knownFor: The production drafting backbone that still sits beside BIM in most offices.
popCaption: AutoCAD 85.8% of firms; AutoCAD Architecture 53.1%; AutoCAD MEP 27.4% (Confluence 2025) · G2: about 1,800–2,012 AutoCAD reviews, 4.4/5 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Universal DWG skills and huge existing drawing libraries
con: Not a full BIM authoring environment on its own
costCaption: Official Autodesk list: $2,095/year or $260/month (autodesk.com/products/autocad/buy, checked Nov 2026).

name: SketchUp
knownFor: Fast conceptual and schematic modeling used early in design and by many contractors.
popCaption: 73.5% of firms (Confluence 2025) · G2: 1,328 reviews, 4.5/5 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Quick to learn and excellent for massing and client conversation models
con: BIM documentation depth is limited compared with Revit or Archicad
costCaption: Official Trimble plans: Pro $399/year ($33.25/mo billed annually); Studio $859/year. Rated on Pro, the usual commercial desktop seat (sketchup.trimble.com/en/plans-and-pricing, checked Nov 2026).

name: Rhino + VisualARQ
knownFor: Freeform and computational modeling, with VisualARQ adding BIM objects and IFC to Rhino.
popCaption: Rhino in 49.6% of firms; Grasshopper 51.3%; Rhino.Inside.Revit 45.1% (Confluence 2025). VisualARQ itself was listed by only 3 firms · checked Nov 2026
pro: Unmatched for complex geometry and Grasshopper workflows
con: The BIM layer (VisualARQ) is much less widely adopted than Rhino itself
costCaption: Perpetual licenses, not a subscription: RhinoARQ bundle $1,695, or Rhino 8 commercial about $995 plus VisualARQ 3 about $795 (visualarq.com/sales and McNeel Miami, checked Nov 2026). Rated on the first-year purchase.

name: Autodesk Forma
knownFor: Early-stage site, massing, and environmental analysis that can feed a Revit model.
popCaption: 76 firms listed Forma (Autodesk) in the Confluence 2025 inventory (a second Autodesk Forma row shows 2; treated cautiously) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Fast contextual studies without opening a full authoring model
con: Inventory counts in the survey are inconsistently labeled, so the exact adoption figure is less clean than Revit's
costCaption: Forma Site Design official list: $700/year, $85/month, or $2,100 for 3 years. Also included in the AEC Collection (autodesk.com/products/forma-site-design/overview, checked Nov 2026).

name: Tekla Structures
knownFor: Structural BIM for steel and concrete detailing through fabrication.
popCaption: 17 firms (~15%) in the architecture-weighted Confluence 2025 survey · G2: 63 reviews, 4.5/5. Structural shops are under-counted in that sample · checked Nov 2026
pro: Constructible steel and concrete detail that can go to the shop
con: A specialist tool; few architecture-firm survey respondents listed it
costCaption: No public US list price found; Trimble sells subscription plans by quote (tekla.com/products/tekla-structures/subscription, checked Nov 2026). Editorial estimate $$$$ (quote-only enterprise).

name: Archicad
knownFor: Full BIM authoring with a strong architecture focus and openBIM/IFC workflows.
popCaption: Only 10 firms in Confluence 2025 (US-heavy sample). European Architectural Barometer Q4 2025: e.g. 61% of French and 51% of German BIM-user firms reported Archicad · G2: 291–298 reviews, 4.6/5 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Native macOS, strong documentation, and solid IFC round-trips
con: Much less common than Revit in US production offices
costCaption: Official US list: Archicad Studio $2,414/year per seat; Collaborate $2,840; Max $5,700 (graphisoft.com/en-us/pricing/, checked Nov 2026). Rated on Studio, the entry commercial seat.

name: Bentley OpenBuildings Designer
knownFor: Building design in Bentley's infrastructure and iTwin world, often on campuses and industrial work.
popCaption: 11 firms listed OpenBuildings Designer (AECOsim) in Confluence 2025 · G2: 16 reviews, 4.3/5 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Fits civil and campus projects already standardized on Bentley
con: Small presence in typical building-design office surveys
costCaption: No public list price confirmed on Bentley.com this session; sold as a subscription or quote. Editorial estimate $$$$ (quote-only enterprise) · checked Nov 2026.

name: Vectorworks Architect
knownFor: Design-oriented BIM used in architecture, landscape, and entertainment.
popCaption: 6 firms listed Vectorworks Architect in Confluence 2025 · G2: 216–264 reviews, 4.4/5 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Flexible 2D/3D in one file and a loyal design-firm user base
con: Low penetration in the large US AEC firms captured by Confluence 2025
costCaption: Official annual subscription $1,530/year ($127.50/mo equivalent, billed annually) (customers.vectorworks.net/subscriptions, checked Nov 2026).

name: ALLPLAN
knownFor: Architectural and structural BIM, especially strong in Europe and reinforcement detailing.
popCaption: Not listed in the Confluence 2025 US-heavy inventory. European Architectural Barometer Q4 2025: 19% of German and 14% of Spanish BIM-user firms reported Allplan · G2: 25 reviews, 4.4/5 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Strong concrete reinforcement and European documentation workflows
costCaption: Official shop: Concept $2,892/year; Basic $1,680; Professional $3,588; Ultimate $4,848 (allplan.com/en-US/shop/products, checked Nov 2026, excl. VAT). Rated on Concept, the essential BIM edition.

name: BricsCAD BIM
knownFor: DWG-compatible CAD with BIM tools, often considered as a lower-cost AutoCAD-class alternative.
popCaption: Only 2 firms listed BricsCAD in Confluence 2025 · G2: 135 reviews, 4.5/5 for BricsCAD overall (not BIM-only) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Familiar DWG workflows on Windows, macOS, and Linux
con: Very little evidence of use as a primary BIM platform in the 2025 firm survey
costCaption: US reseller Novedge lists $1,166/year for a 1-year single subscription (checked Nov 2026). A clear USD figure was not confirmed on bricsys.com this session. Editorial estimate $$.
